cc:Work.dc:title: Misc - PhoneHolder
cc:Work.dc:description:
Smartphone desk holder
This phone stand holds your phone between two tabs, with access to its bottom, in order to connect a charger, headphones, and also not to obstruct the mic.
Default values are currently based on Galaxy S7.
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes PhoneHolder --phone_height 200 --phone_width 120 --phone_depth 9 --angle 15 --bottom_margin 40 --tab_size 90 --bottom_support_spacing 3 --thickness 4 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes PhoneHolder --phone_height --phone_width --phone_depth --angle --bottom_margin --tab_size --bottom_support_spacing --thickness --reference --labels
